title: Welcome to WikiEngine
content:
WikiEngine is a modern, open-source wiki platform designed for teams and organizations to collaborate on documentation.

Key Features

  • Easy-to-use editing interface
  • User authentication and access control
  • Customizable themes and styling
  • RESTful API for integrations

Getting Started

Create an account to start contributing to the wiki. Once logged in, you can access theme customization in the Settings page.

title: Documentation
content:
This section contains the official WikiEngine documentation.

API Reference

WikiEngine provides a RESTful API for programmatic access to wiki features.

Endpoints

  • GET /api/templates/custom-presets - List custom CSS presets
  • POST /api/templates/custom-presets/{filename} - Create a new preset (requires authentication)
  • GET /api/user/profile - Get current user profile

Theme Customization

Authenticated users can create custom CSS presets through the Settings page. Presets are stored in the custom/css-presets/ directory.
